subject: BioCrest: request for reservation grace + H200 pricing carveout
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire@biocrest.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BioCrest Procurement <procurement@biocrest.ai>
Date: 2027-03-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated reservation ask — H200 allocation + transient burst buffer

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re moving quickly on the POC and Procurement asked me to surface two asks that are blocking signature: a) BioCrest needs an H200-backed Dedicated pool for the inference workloads (model fidelity matters) but the procurement team is pushing for parity pricing with our existing H100 tickets — they asked if Redwood can offer a one-time pricing carveout for the base reservation to match H100 unit rates for the first 12 months, and b) they want a 30-day reservation hold (start delay) while they complete budget approvals, plus an initial 10% burst credit for the first quarter in case training/ingestion spikes.

Attached a draft SOW and a capacity matrix for the first 6 months. Can you escalate for any executive signoff required? This is a high-priority renewal pipeline motion for us.

Claire Hammond
Head of Cloud Operations, BioCrest Therapeutics
Attachments: BioCrest_SOW_draft.pdf, capacity_matrix.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated reservation ask — H200 allocation + transient burst buffer

Looping you both in — BioCrest (deal DEAL-BIO-2027-034) is asking for two non-standard terms: pricing parity for H200 (effectively an H100-rate carveout for 12 months) and a 30-day reservation start delay with a 10% burst credit for Q1.

Why this matters: BioCrest is a mid-market therapeutics SaaS vendor with strong LTV and a fast-moving POC. If we move quickly we can convert to Dedicated committed within 60 days. Margin impact sketch: H200 cost delta is material vs H100; need finance and deal desk run. Aditya — can you confirm technical compatibility (H200 only) and whether we can guarantee equivalent latency profile if we route to H200 family?

My recommended ask to execs: conditional 6-month H100-equivalent pricing on the base reservation (not burst) or a blended floor that limits downside; 30-day hold with automatic activation on signature; cap burst credits to 10% of committed monthly spend for Q1. Please advise quickly — procurement asked for a signoff timeline today.

— Irene
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Dedicated reservation ask — H200 allocation + transient burst buffer

Irene, I agree we should move fast but preserve margin. Quick calc: at projected committed units (6k unit-hrs/mo) the delta between H200 and H100 list is ~37% additional infra spend. If we carve H200 onto H100 rate for 12 months that’s ~25% margin hit before any cross-charges. Proposed counter: offer a time-limited blended discount instead — equivalent to ~10% off on H200 vs list for 6 months, with a 30-day hold and 10% burst credit limited to $X (we should define $X = 10% of monthly committed spend). That keeps us commercial flexibility and keeps finance exposure bounded.

Marissa — I need a short exec summary + ask (1-sentence approval request) I can pass to the CRO/CEO for co-sign today. Vivek — requesting finance cap approval on the proposed blended concession.

-Lauren
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: RE: Fwd: Dedicated reservation ask — H200 allocation + transient burst buffer

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers and will approve a constrained concession with these conditions: 1) Blended H200 concession equal to 10% off published H200 rate for the first 3 billing cycles (not 6), 2) Reservation hold up to 30 days allowed but activation must happen within 60 days of DocuSign signature otherwise the reservation converts to an auto-cancel with a 30% rebooking fee, 3) Burst credit capped to the lesser of 10% of committed monthly spend or $25k for Q1, 4) All concessions to be documented in a short amendment and require Exec co-sign (CRO + CFO).

I’m OK with the commercial here provided Legal and Deal Desk lock the amendment language; finance will track the realized delta to P&L and can request clawbacks in quarter if usage patterns materially differ.

-Vivek
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hammond <claire@biocrest.ai>
Cc: BioCrest Procurement <procurement@biocrest.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated reservation ask — H200 allocation + transient burst buffer

Claire — appreciate the urgency and the packet you sent. We have an interim approval path. Summary of what we can sign to today: 1) A short amendment that grants a limited commercial concession: a 10% blended discount off H200 list for the first three billing cycles (applies to base reservation only), 2) A reservation start hold up to 30 days; activation must be completed within 60 days of signature or the reservation will auto-cancel with a rebooking fee per Vivek’s note, 3) A burst protection credit capped at the lesser of 10% of monthly committed spend or $25,000 for Q1 only.

Next steps: I’m attaching the amendment template (redwood-reserve-term-sheet-v3.docx) and the SOW you provided. If BioCrest agrees, sign the DocuSign linked here (https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-98765) and we’ll route for CRO + CFO co-sign within 24 hours. Legal will send final amendment language for countersign by EOD.

We’re excited to support BioCrest — once signed we’ll queue the dedicated pool and confirm an activation date.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-reserve-term-sheet-v3.docx, BioCrest_SOW_draft.pdf
